description: Detects a file-integrity change to a web application's own login/authentication page (logon.aspx, auth.asp, owa/logon.aspx) outside a change window -- a modified login page can silently capture and exfiltrate submitted credentials before forwarding the real request, a portal-capture form of input capture.

data_sources.description: Sysmon operational log (File Creation) -- requires Sysmon installed with a configuration that logs the relevant event ID(s).

detection_logic: Hand-authored SPL grounded in MITRE ATT&CK Detection Analytic AN1321 for T1056.003 (Web Portal Capture). Detects a file-integrity change to a web application's own login/authentication page (logon.aspx, auth.asp, owa/logon.aspx) outside a change window -- a modified login page can silently capture and exfiltrate submitted credentials before forwarding the real request, a portal-capture form of input capture.
spl:
sourcetype=WinEventLog:Sysmon EventCode=11 (TargetFilename="*\\logon.aspx" OR TargetFilename="*\\owa\\*.aspx" OR TargetFilename="*\\auth.asp*")
| lookup change_windows dvc OUTPUT in_window
| where isnull(in_window) OR in_window=0
| stats count min(_time) as firstTime by ComputerName TargetFilename Image User
| eval firstTime=strftime(firstTime, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
tuning_guidance: Adapt sourcetypes/field names to the specific Windows Event Log forwarding pipeline in use (Splunk Add-on for Microsoft Windows, Sysmon TA, or equivalent). Populate the reference lookup table(s) this search depends on before deploying: change_windows.

Escalate to endpoint response to validate host integrity (full IOC sweep, memory acquisition) if compromise is suspected.
